d:
Bihar men in dinon ek shadi ki khub charcha hai. shadi kisi aam parivar men nahin, balki mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ke ghar hone ja rahi hai. unki chhoti beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan joron par hain. karib ek mahine se anant sinh ke aavas par shadi ki taiyariyan chal rahi hain aur ab in taiyariyon ke bich ek aisi gari pahunchi hai, jisne logon ka dhyan apni or khinch liya hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
